handling.actualEgressStatement: Approved local public-repository metadata, selected source/document content and derived findings were processed in the active OpenAI Codex session. Assessment collection used no network provider, registry, scanner or remote GitHub/CI query. The user separately authorized commits and pushes of reviewed assessment artifacts to the existing origin remote.
redactions: No raw source excerpts, credential values, private overlays or author identities are included.
Evidence uses portable repository-relative paths; aggregate counts and team roles replace personal activity.

permissionsGaps.impact: The report is partial; missing evidence is not a pass and no numeric maturity score or delivery authorization is inferred.
permissionsGaps.summary: Five applicable reference rules lack enough combined implementation/runtime evidence for a full pass. No approved standards-exception registry or modernization specification was supplied; frontend rules are mapped selectively to the observed static-site application.
Service region, retention/deletion and approval expiry are not supplied by local repository evidence.
permissionsGaps.impact: Owner governance details remain unknown; assessment findings await user review.

collectionErrors.summary: The generic report-portfolio/application-style-conformance.json path was absent. The prompt's explicit application-standards-contract.json and application-standards/style-conformance-rules.json were read successfully.
collectionErrors.impact: Recovered lookup; all six reference rules were available. No failure was converted into a pass.

findings.title: Accessibility verification has no recorded completion evidence
findings.description: The repository provides a concrete nine-item manual accessibility checklist, but every item remains unchecked. The local CI definitions validate generated structure and links but do not record keyboard, screen-reader, zoom, responsive, contrast, print, or reduced-motion results. This is an evidence gap, not a finding that the site itself fails accessibility requirements.

remediation.summary: Execute the documented manual accessibility matrix against a representative site build and retain dated evidence, automating only repeatable checks that complement rather than replace assistive-technology review.
steps: Run the existing checklist against the homepage, catalog, one short guide, and one long guide.
Record date, browser, viewport, assistive technology, outcome, and any follow-up finding without personal data.
Add bounded automated accessibility checks for repeatable regressions if they can run within the approved tool and dependency policy.
Verify all nine checklist areas have current evidence or an explicit blocked/accepted disposition.
